rule: Successful Pump.fun create. Live mode enrolls from collection start for 24 hours; fixture mode uses the protocol window.
Live T0 is collection start; T+24h ends the 24-hour collection and T+60h is 36 hours later. Fixture mode uses block_time.
Public http(s) URI is requested on IPv4. ipfs:// and ar:// keep the original URI and record the gateway route. Local and private hosts are not collected. Failures are retried.
